Admin Portal

Complete guide for platform administrators — manage vendors, smart vases, customers, orders and payments.

FlowerShop IoT Platform

Authentication

Login Page

The Admin Portal login screen. Enter your username and password then click Sign In. Use your platform administrator credentials. Click Forgot password? if you need to reset your password.

Forgot Password

Password reset page. Enter your username or registered email address and a reset link will be sent. This page is accessible without logging in.

Dashboard

Dashboard Overview

The main dashboard shows a summary of platform activity including vendor counts, vase statistics, recent orders and revenue metrics. Use the top navigation bar to move between sections.

Vendor Management

All Vendors

Lists all registered vendors (Traditional Shops and Freelance Florists). Each card shows the vendor name, address, type badge, and number of registered vases. Click View Details to open a vendor's profile.

Create New Vendor

Form to onboard a new vendor. Fill in the business name, type (Traditional Shop or Freelance Florist), contact details, and address. Submitting creates a Keycloak account for the vendor admin and registers them in the platform.

Vendor Details

Full vendor profile showing business information, contact details, assigned vases, and order history. Admins can suspend the vendor account or edit their profile from this page.

Pending Installations

Lists vases that have been registered but not yet confirmed as installed at the vendor's premises. Track which devices are awaiting physical setup.

Smart Vase Management

All Smart Vases

Table view of every registered IoT vase across all vendors. Columns show the device ID, owning vendor, activation status, connection health (Online/Offline), and time of last heartbeat. Click Details to drill into a specific device.

Vase Details

Detailed view of a single IoT vase: serial number, location coordinates, current bouquet assignment, sensor data, and full heartbeat history. The health indicator shows whether the device is reporting normally.

Register New Vase

Form to register a new ESP32 SmartVase device. Provide the device serial number, select the owning vendor, and enter the physical installation location. Once registered the device can connect via MQTT.

Customer Management

All Customers

Searchable list of all registered customers. Columns show full name, email, account status, and registration date. Use the search box to filter by name or email. Click Details for a full profile.

Customer Details

Full customer profile: personal information, order history, saved addresses, and active subscriptions. Admins can view all purchases and manage account status from this page.

Orders

All Orders

Platform-wide order list showing every purchase across all vendors. Filter by status (Paid, Preparing, Delivered, Cancelled). Each row shows the order ID, customer, vendor, total value, and current status.

Payments

All Payments

Payment ledger showing all Stripe transactions on the platform. Columns include order reference, customer, amount, currency, payment status, and transaction date. Useful for reconciliation and dispute investigation.
